Bug_Title: "wait" should not be called when multiple locks are held
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by having threadA acquire locks on mon1 and mon2, and then calling wait() on mon2 while still holding the lock on mon1. This results in threadB being unable to acquire the lock on mon1, leading to a deadlock.
Trigger_Explanation: The testDeadlock method calls the showBug method of the DeadlockExample class, which triggers the bug by having threadA acquire locks on mon1 and mon2, and then calling wait() on mon2 while still holding the lock on mon1. This results in threadB being unable to acquire the lock on mon1, leading to a deadlock.
